g.title: Asks for a page route such as /dashboard. Middleware handles the request before any page renders, and the first paint already has data. After that, client components take over with TanStack Query.
Runs on page routes only, not on /api. Refreshes the Supabase session cookie and redirects signed-out visitors from /dashboard, /tasks, /analytics and /settings to /login.
The dashboard, lanes and task pages. Each calls getAuthUser(), then read tasks through Prisma with the same creator-or-assignee filter as the API, so the first render already has data.
Email and password plus GitHub OAuth. The middleware refreshes the session cookie against it on every page request.
Tasks, task events, notifications, users, handoff templates, GitHub tokens and Slack installations. Composite indexes on assignee and creator with updatedAt back the dashboard query.
